intro: In Moonbrook, explosions beneath Westfall draw SI:7's attention. Jasper Fel, a Stormwind operative, sends a remote detonator kit to help handle the work from a safe distance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.
If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.
Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
